stage0056_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「However mighty $c may be,
　spreading their forces thin won't do」

stage0056_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「No need to mobilize the main force.
　We'll crush them with what we have...!」

stage0056_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$レイアム$$
「It seems Geminis is fielding captured
　machines as their own forces」

stage0056_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Even some are from the Altair army...!」

stage0056_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Launch all units!
　Don't let Geminis near the fleet!」

stage0056_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「VF-25s carry reaction warheads and MDE rounds,
　VF-22s carry reaction warheads.
　Use them at the right moment, everyone」

stage0056_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アルト$$
「Roger!
　Today, I'll grab their tail for sure!」

stage0056_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$アルト$$'s fired up.
　Maybe because his sponsor's watching」

stage0056_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Get a grip, $$アンディ$$...!
　The enemy's here!」

stage0056_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シュレード$$
「No good, this one.
　He's useless right now」

stage0056_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$... do you know what
　happened to $$アンディ$$?」

stage0056_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I don't know...!
　Not about some hole-digging guy!」

stage0056_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong, $n?
　You look so serious...」

stage0056_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Working with Geminis to crush us...!?」

stage0056_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$n
「Wait, Captain $$オズマ$$.
　That person came to help us, I hear」

stage0056_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I've told $n about my situation.
　First, let's repel Geminis」

stage0056_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I'll back you up, $n」

stage0056_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「The one who got in our way at Orb...!」

stage0056_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$,
　thinking it'll all go your way is a grave mistake」

stage0056_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And I'll teach you the error
　of thinking all of Chrono
　has bowed to you」

stage0056_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, work with $$アドヴェント$$
　and repel Geminis!」

stage0056_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$桂$$
「$n!
　I'm leaving watch on him to you!」

stage0056_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Now, let's go, $n...!
　Protect humanity's history with your own hands!」

stage0056_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Guh!
　I can't face the captain after this!」

stage0056_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$n
「$$アンナロッタ$$!
　Don't think you can get away!」

stage0056_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Persistent!
　But today, I'll finish this once and for all!」

stage0056_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$n
「Good resolve, $$アンナロッタ$$!
　Don't run off halfway!」

stage0056_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have business with that woman too」

stage0056_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What is that unit...!?
　It's completely different
　from the Altair army we've seen!」

stage0056_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Like the damned souls of hell...
　Seems he's brought trouble with him」

stage0056_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You mean to interfere with our fight!?」

stage0056_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Is that all?
　Seems I needn't bother with you」

stage0056_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Be gone.
　I've no time to waste on the likes of you」

stage0056_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...All units, fall back...
　Hurry...!」

stage0056_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$シン$$
「No way he was helping us...」

stage0056_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah... his hostility's clearly aimed at us」

stage0056_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Show me that power of yours」

stage0056_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$桂$$
「But he left behind one hell of a parting gift!」

stage0056_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, intercept the Altair army.
　This is a fight against an unknown enemy.
　Stay alert」

stage0056_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Every time we meet, that man weighs
　on my mind more... What is this feeling...）

stage0056_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed distortion in the dimensional
　boundary...! Likely reinforcements!」

stage0056_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$オットー$$
「Argh!
　$$時空震動$$s are fine, but no more enemies!」

stage0056_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is bad!
　The fleet will get caught in the fight there!」

stage0056_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$n
「That man... just what is he!?
　Is he moving with some other aim than the Altair army!?」

stage0056_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「When did he get aboard the Quarter!?」

stage0056_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ゲパルト$$, $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!
　$$スパーダ$$, $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0056_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Supreme Commander!
　Not $$アンディ$$, not in that state...!」

stage0056_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Supreme Commander!
　You'd have $$アンディ$$ fight like that!?」

stage0056_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right.
　$$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$...!
　Fall as far as you must!」

stage0056_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「As if he's being swallowed by his own heart's hole!」

stage0056_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Please, make him stop!
　At this rate...」

stage0056_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$不動$$
「To fall to the earth...
　is the start of new life」

stage0056_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「What are you talking about?」

stage0056_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$不動$$
「A seed that falls to earth sprouts,
　and in time bears fruit in abundance...
　carrying new life to the next generation!」

stage0056_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So I should... pin my hopes on the next life...」

stage0056_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$不動$$
「But if you don't try to change yourself,
　nothing will change, even if
　12,000 years pass!」

stage0056_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$不動$$
「Use your power to bind everyone's hearts」

stage0056_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$不動$$
「And then, the banana turns toward the sun!」

stage0056_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't really get it, but...!」

stage0056_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right!
　It's the warmth of a foot bath!!」

stage0056_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$不動$$
「In ancient alchemy, a man and woman boiled
　together in one pot meant filling each
　other's lack and being reborn as one」

stage0056_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$不動$$
「You too shared your hearts in the hot water
　and became one, surely.
　Remember that now」

stage0056_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Anyway, what do the Commander's bananas mean?」

stage0056_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$不動$$
「You are all still unripe bananas」

stage0056_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$不動$$
「The serpent that tempted Eve in Atlandia's garden
　hid itself in a banana tree...」

stage0056_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$不動$$
「A banana is paradise's fruit, the sun's fruit...!
　As it ripens, it rises erect toward the sun!」

stage0056_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I'm warming up... from the depths of my body!」

stage0056_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Guooooah!
　The banana inside me rises too!」

stage0056_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$桂$$
「Not bad at all!
　I'm all for a turn like this!」

stage0056_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I wonder how many times I've said that line...」

stage0056_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
（This is a mingling of... hot water? No, water...!）

stage0056_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$不動$$
（And so it becomes a guidepost to the sun...!）

stage0056_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Alright, let's go, $$ＭＩＸ$$, $$アマタ$$!
　We'll clean up the rest of these skeletons in one go!」

stage0056_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「It's fine, $$アンディ$$.
　Your feelings got through to me.」

stage0056_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Don't get carried away!
　That's a whole different matter!」

stage0056_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ah! $$アンディ$$'s at it again!」

stage0056_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I don't care about that!
　Just get out there and fight, $$アンディ$$!!」

stage0056_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$不動$$
「Heh... still got a ways to go.」

stage0056_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Doesn't look like there's any reinforcements either.」

stage0056_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アルト$$
「But still, just who was that...?
　The man who summoned the skeletons...?」

stage0056_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$ called that person $$ミカゲ$$.」

stage0056_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I volunteered to play messenger,
　but I gained more from it than I expected...」

stage0056_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「As for our innocence, ask $n about it.
　When your memory-seal breaks, the real fight begins.」

stage0056_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Just $$アドヴェント$$ is fine.」

stage0056_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「...What do you know about the angel...?」

stage0056_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's my archenemy... my fate, you might say.」

stage0056_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Being able to help you is my pleasure.
　Until we meet again!」

stage0056_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Refreshing, and warm...
　Like someone made from May sunshine.」

stage0056_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What do you make of it, $$アムロ$$?」

stage0056_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't get any sense of a hidden agenda.」

stage0056_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But since we can't see the full picture on
　Chrono yet, we shouldn't get overconfident.」

stage0056_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アルト$$
「Maybe he's after $$ガドライト$$ too,
　same as you.」

stage0056_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's taking damage from $$バサラ$$'s singing!?」

stage0056_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
（A clash between positive power and negative power...
　The positive power won out, did it.）

stage0056_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Let's go all out, $$バサラ$$!
　Looks like it can't stand our singing!」

stage0056_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$バサラ$$
「No way that's true!
　Once it hears my song, war ought to seem pointless!」

stage0056_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I come, skeletons!
　It's bone-rattling rock time!!」

stage0056_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You've grown sharper since we last met, $n.」

stage0056_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「If it's you, you can surpass that $$ガドライト$$!
　Let's go!」

stage0056_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So the Imitation's teamed up with our nuisance!」

stage0056_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't allow him to be called the Imitation.
　He's the one man who holds the potential
　to surpass $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ himself.」

stage0056_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's go, $n!
　Defeating her will be our declaration
　of war against $$ガドライト$$!」

stage0056_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Seeing these skeletons
　makes something deep in my chest ache...）

stage0056_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Is this connected too, to the memories
　that Geminis sealed away...?）

stage0056_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「W-wait, $$バサラ$$!
　That's a bit much, no matter how you spin it!」

stage0056_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$バサラ$$
「My song could make museum dinosaurs get up and dance!」

stage0056_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That's how it is!
　Now hear my soooong!!」

stage0056_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$アムロ$$
（That man... going out of his way to come
　to my room, just what was he after...）

stage0056_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
（He's making moves unlike the usual
　Altair Army... I should stay wary...）
